{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"0000000000000EJPJCZSGWEZW5","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=down
group discord "Discord" {
  node App "Discord App"
  node Guild "Guild"
  node DChannel "Discord Channel"
}
group cloud "EDGE" {
  node Service "Discord Service" ref="packages/services/compute-service/src/discord/discord-bot.ts"
  node Install "Installation"
  node Binding "Binding"
  node Process "Agent Process"
}
group space "Space" {
  node Plugin "plugin-agent" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-agent/src/AgentPlugin.ts"
  node Agent "Agent"
  node Chat "Chat"
}
edge Guild one-to-many DChannel
edge Install -> App
edge Install -> Guild
edge Service one-to-many Install
edge Install one-to-many Binding
edge Binding -> DChannel
edge Binding -> Agent
edge Service -> Process "routes"
edge Process -> Chat
edge Agent one-to-many Chat
edge Plugin -> Binding "administers"
"},"objects":[
